description: This file defines a ChatLog component class for managing chat message components in a TUI (Text User Interface). It manages user and assistant messages, tool execution components, system messages, and inline messages, providing methods for adding, updating, and removing these components to facilitate chat interactions within a terminal-based UI.

classes.name: ChatLog
classes.description: A class representing a chat log component that manages chat messages, system messages, tool executions, and inline messages in a TUI. It supports adding, updating, pruning, and clearing chat components to facilitate interactive chat UI within terminal applications.

methods.name: dropComponentReferences
methods.description: Removes references to a given component from internal maps, used during component removal to avoid orphaned references.

methods.name: pruneOverflow
methods.description: Removes oldest components when maximum number of components is exceeded to keep the chat log within size constraints.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a new component to the chat log and prunes overflow if necessary.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Clears all chat components and internal state; can preserve pending user messages if specified.

methods.name: restorePendingUsers
methods.description: Restores pending user messages into the chat if they have not been finalized or cleared.

methods.name: clearPendingUsers
methods.description: Removes all pending user message components from the chat.

methods.name: createSystemMessage
methods.description: Creates a system message container with styled text.

methods.name: addSystem
methods.description: Adds a system message to the chat log.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Adds a user message component to the chat log.

methods.name: addPendingUser
methods.description: Adds a pending user message, used during the process of user message input or loading.

methods.name: commitPendingUser
methods.description: Finalizes a pending user message by removing it from pending state.

methods.name: dropPendingUser
methods.description: Removes a pending user message from the chat by runId.

methods.name: hasPendingUser
methods.description: Checks if there is a pending user message with a given runId.

methods.name: reconcilePendingUsers
methods.description: Matches pending user messages with stored history, removing those that are confirmed present.

methods.name: countPendingUsers
methods.description: Returns the number of currently pending user messages.

methods.name: resolveRunId
methods.description: Resolves a runId to a string identifier, defaulting to 'default' if none provided.

methods.name: startAssistant
methods.description: Begins an assistant message stream with specified text, optionally with a runId.

methods.name: updateAssistant
methods.description: Updates the text of an ongoing assistant message.

methods.name: finalizeAssistant
methods.description: Finalizes and removes an assistant message, replacing it if necessary.

methods.name: dropAssistant
methods.description: Removes an ongoing assistant message stream.

methods.name: showBtw
methods.description: Displays an inline message with question and result, updating existing message if present.

methods.name: dismissBtw
methods.description: Removes the inline message.

methods.name: hasVisibleBtw
methods.description: Checks if an inline message is currently visible.

methods.name: startTool
methods.description: Starts or updates a tool execution component with provided arguments.

methods.name: updateToolArgs
methods.description: Updates the arguments for an ongoing tool execution.

methods.name: updateToolResult
methods.description: Sets the result of a tool execution, marking errors or partial results if needed.

methods.name: setToolsExpanded
methods.description: Expands or collapses all tool components.
